releaseNotes:
Combined changes from 1.17.99 through 1.17.113.

### Ticketek Marketplace

• **New MP Clipper:** Copy a completed purchase straight into your spreadsheet as one row. Includes ticket quantity, account email, section/row/seats, total, buyer name, card label, category/restrictions, event date and event name. No order reference or version column.

• Buyer name and your custom card labels stay saved after closing the browser. Account email is filled automatically when available, with an Edit option if needed. Choose the card label yourself—Clickerist does not read card details.

• MP Clipper appears only on the confirmation page. The compact main screen fits without scrolling for normal ticket summaries. After copying, it shows **“Copied as clipper!”**

• **Clearer ticket details:** Review Order and payment show your event, seats, category, ticket count, fees and total. Fixed details disappearing between pages or needing a refresh before they appeared. Details carried forward are labelled as saved from Review Order.

• Review Order no longer says “ready to start” or uses an old ticket-lock banner to declare the booking failed. Clicking stops during review/payment; a purchase is only marked confirmed after the actual success message appears.

• **Better Activity Log:** Confirmed purchases and cache-clearing results now appear in the log. Purchase entries do not duplicate when reopening the popup, and clearing the log keeps them cleared.

• Improved category rescanning, missing categories and original-price detection. When a category has several original prices, Clickerist says the price varies instead of showing a misleading profit.

### Right-click shortcuts

• **Ticketmaster:** Open High Demand or Low Demand view without editing the link. Existing presale link options are kept; Ticketmaster decides which view is available.

• **Ticketek:** Choose **Open with presale code**, enter your code and apply it in the same tab. Existing link options are preserved. This option is not shown on Marketplace.

• **Ticketek and Marketplace:** Choose **Clear this site’s cache** without clearing cookies, login data or settings. A small message and Activity Log entry show the result. Fixed unnecessary blocking on normal Marketplace and “Something went wrong” pages.

• Ticketmaster keeps **Clear this site’s data** with confirmation, because it can sign you out or remove your booking session. Cache-only clearing is unavailable in Firefox and private/incognito mode.

### Ticket selection fixes

• Fixed same-name tickets at different prices sharing the wrong price or preventing Start on Ticketek/Ticketmaster.

• Improved blank category lists, sold-out price information and availability labels. Missing information is shown as unknown instead of guessed.

### Easier bug reports

• Use **Capture debug report** in Activity Log to select a screenshot area and include recent activity and event/category details. Review it before saving or sending—nothing is sent automatically.

### Before updating

Reload Clickerist and refresh ticket pages **before your next booking**, not during an active hold or payment. Existing missing order details cannot be recovered from the payment form. Payment stays manual, and tools stop when booking or security checks make an action unsafe. Review screenshots for personal information before sharing.
